_comment: Standalone transform control: MUST ESCAPE the single import-only test, which imports the harness without driving either installer.
subject: CONTROL: reorder independent restarts

mutants.label: CONTROL: reorder independent restarts
mutants.new:
SWAP_SERVICE="$SERVICE_NAME"; SERVICE_NAME="$AI_SERVICE_NAME"; AI_SERVICE_NAME="$SWAP_SERVICE"
trap 'if [ "${RESTARTS_SEEN:-0}" = 2 ]; then SWAP_SERVICE="$SERVICE_NAME"; SERVICE_NAME="$AI_SERVICE_NAME"; AI_SERVICE_NAME="$SWAP_SERVICE"; trap - DEBUG; elif [[ "$BASH_COMMAND" == sudo\ systemctl\ restart* ]]; then RESTARTS_SEEN=$((${RESTARTS_SEEN:-0} + 1)); fi' DEBUG
echo
